attributes.residual:
BASELINE, live and previously unrecorded: fuzzy 90.0583%, real 885, insns T857/O856, multiset 11t. This is the CLOSEST large unmatched function in Game Code by opcode multiset -- eleven tokens and a one-instruction count difference across 857 instructions -- which makes it a strong exact-closure candidate rather than an impact-grinding one, and reclassifies how the lane should treat it.

THE RESIDUAL IS EXACTLY TWO MECHANISMS. (a) NARROW RE-EXTEND, three sites, target-only +3 clrlwi. against ours-only -3 cmplwi, at target 0x45c, 0x78c and 0x86c. Each site is identical in shape: `lbz r0,N(r1)` then target `clrlwi. r0,r0,24` where we emit `cmplwi r0,0`. The three memory operands are the `u8 volatile` flags `needCheck` (slot 152), `needUnmount` (153) and `found`. Per claim.law.narrow-local-reextend-on-read.20260830.v1 the target's mask says its local is narrow and being re-extended on read; ours is not re-extending. The explicit `(u8)` cast does NOT force it -- MWCC folds a no-op cast on an already-u8 operand and the object came out byte-identical -- so the lever is elsewhere. The untried hypothesis, and it is the one to run next: the `volatile` qualifier on these three locals is reconstruction scaffold, and it is what tells MWCC the loaded value is already 8-bit; the shape to test is a NON-volatile narrow local that is memory-homed for a different reason (address-taken, or written across the `goto retry` back-edge), which is the exact configuration the law was derived from. (b) BRANCH PAIR, target-only +2 b at 0x9d4/0x9d8. After `cmpwi r3,-2 / bge ->6c` the target emits `b ->9dc` followed by an unreachable `b ->6c`; ours falls through into 0x9cc directly. This is the CARDDelete switch at source line 1313 and it is the classic peephole-off goto-pair tell. Reordering the default arm does not produce it -- MWCC normalises case order and the object was byte-identical -- so the pair comes from the case BODIES, not their order; the untried shape is an explicit empty case or a `break` in the default arm followed by a separate exit, rather than `goto retry`.

Also open, smaller: target-only +1 mr against ours-only -2 addi at 0x950 (an argument set-up form), and roughly a dozen adjacent `li` pairs that swap order throughout -- pure schedule, not worth a probe until (a) and (b) close.

NEXT AGENT: do NOT re-probe the explicit `(u8)` cast at these three sites (byte-identical, measured) or the default-first switch reordering (byte-identical, measured). Both were folded away by the front end, which is a stronger negative than a score regression: the source text never reached codegen.
